knimeNode.name: Spark Unpivot (DX)
knimeNode.shortDescription: Unpivots (melts) selected value columns into two columns: ColumnNames / ColumnValues.

fullDescription.intro: This node performs an Unpivot (melt) operation on Spark data. Selected value columns are transformed into rows.
fullDescription.option: Columns that will be kept as-is for each produced row.
If enabled, rows with missing values in the pivoted columns may be dropped (implementation on Spark side).
